featured_reviews.name: Imran Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Trends Footwear at Infiniti Mall offers a decent selection of casual and formal shoes at budget-friendly prices. The store layout is clean and easy to navigate, with a variety of styles for men, women, and kids. From everyday sandals to trendy sneakers and ethnic footwear, there’s something for most tastes.
👟 Product Range
The collection includes both in-house and popular Indian brands. While the variety is good, some sizes and styles may be limited during sales or peak seasons.
🛍️ Pricing & Offers
Prices are affordable, and the store often runs discounts and combo deals. It’s a good spot for value shopping, especially if you're looking for seasonal or occasion-specific footwear.
👥 Customer Service
Staff are generally polite and helpful, though service can be slow during busy hours. They assist with sizing and availability but may not always be proactive.
📍 Location Convenience
Being inside Infiniti Mall makes it easy to combine your visit with other shopping or dining plans. The store is located on one of the upper floors and is easy to find
